description: Count the flow-meter readings flagged as out of band inside a half-hour window of one shakedown session. DISTILL-CANARY-edddbdaf

files.README.md:
# north-intake flow meter

The meter writes one session file per shakedown. The first line names the
session date, the instrument and the site. Every line after it is one reading,
`<clock time> <level> reading=<litres per minute>`, and the meter sets the level
to ALARM for a reading that falls outside the band it is set for. The reading
lines carry a clock time only, so the session date comes from the header.
